# THE PREMORTEM: Why Origin/Main Broke

## THE FAILURE STORY

By February, six months after the July work was committed, the first integration test against origin/main failed silently. The 43 unmerged commits from the 10 worktrees—the real implementation of system_v5 and system_v7 refactoring—never made it to main. Instead, what landed was the v9 scaffolding commit: 6,637 lines of JSON configuration stubs defining class signatures, function names, import paths. The Python beneath it was hollow: 1,234 lines of `pass`, empty methods, stub return values. The July work—real business logic, database adapters, validation pipelines—lived in the worktrees at f0afdc36a and claimgate/bypass-regression. Nobody integrated them before the v9 scaffolding became canonical.
